text:
Step 1: Create the character sheet first using Gpt Image 2 with any concept you want. my base prompt was: A highly detailed anime-style character design sheet for a [your character], presented in a clean modern concept art layout.
you can then add extra layered details depending on the style and direction you want.

Step 2: Turn it into motion using Seedance 2.0.

so far, this is the cleanest and most dynamic model I’ve tested for maintaining character consistency. even though there are still occasional misses in certain areas, the current results are already very impressive and genuinely helpful for production workflows.

for this video, I used Omni Reference (above) and the second video was used as the first frame.
